sutta: this name list on utah nikaya 46.4.8 where the buddha said that when a person listens to the sutas or dhamma with proper attention at that moment the five hindrances exist not and the seven bojanga factors of enlightenment go to completion now these these two things the five hindrance is not existing at that moment and the seven bojanga being completed are the conditions for attaining arya hood so which means that listening to the sutas with proper attention is the way to attain stream entry again
